mapper.select: SELECT P.ID AS permissionRefId, P.PERMISSION_CODE AS permissionCode, P.OWNER_TYPE AS ownerType FROM PEACH_ROLE R INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = R.TENANT_REF_ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 AND P.DELEGABLE = 1 AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = R.APP_REF_ID) AND ((P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL) OR (P.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID = R.TENANT_REF_ID)) WHERE R.ID = #{roleRefId} AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND R.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId} AND R.ROLE_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 AND P.ID = #{permissionRefId} LIMIT 2

SELECT F.ID AS id, F.FIELD_CODE AS code, F.RESOURCE_CODE AS name, F.MASK_STRATEGY AS resourceType FROM PEACH_FIELD_DEFINITION F WHERE F.RESOURCE_CODE = #{resourceCode} AND F.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND F.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (F.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR F.APP_REF_ID = #{appRefId}) AND ((F.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND F.TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId}) OR (F.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND F.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL AND F.DELEGABLE = 1)) ORDER BY F.FIELD_CODE, F.ID LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
